name: Regularized ML return forecasts (elastic net, trees, neural nets; Gu Kelly Xiu)

origin.source_title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning (NBER w25398; Review of Financial Studies 2020)

how_it_works.simple: You give a computer many facts about each stock and the economy, and it learns which combinations predict next month's return, with rules that stop it from memorizing noise.
how_it_works.analogy: Like a teacher who grades on many small clues but is forced to ignore clues that only worked once.
how_it_works.precise: Forecast monthly excess returns from 94 stock characteristics, their interactions with 8 macro predictors, and industry dummies, comparing OLS, elastic net, PCR, PLS, random forests, boosted trees and neural nets. Train 1957-1974, validate 1975-1986, test 1987-2016 with annual refits.

rule: Each month, fit the model on an expanding window, predict next-month returns for all stocks, and hold a value-weighted long top decile minus short bottom decile portfolio; for elastic net, tune lambda and the L1/L2 mix on the validation window.
data_needed: Monthly stock returns and characteristics (CRSP/Compustat or open versions)
Macro predictors (dividend yield, term spread, default spread, etc.)
economic_rationale: Many weak predictors combine nonlinearly; shrinkage and nonlinearity reduce overfitting compared with OLS on hundreds of signals (Gu, Kelly and Xiu).
why_it_might_fail: Elastic net's out-of-sample R2 was only 0.11 percent per month for individual stocks. Much of the long-short profit may come from small, illiquid stocks, and the paper reports Sharpe ratios before trading costs.

reported_results.source: Gu, Kelly, Xiu NBER w25398, introduction
reported_results.market: About 30,000 US stocks, value-weighted decile long-short
reported_results.notes: Neural network forecasts; equal-weighted 2.45. OLS-3 benchmark: 0.61 value-weighted, 0.83 equal-weighted. Market timing the S&P 500 with NN forecasts: Sharpe 0.77 vs 0.51 buy-and-hold. Elastic net stock-level out-of-sample R2 0.11 percent per month.

post_publication_evidence: Later studies (for example Avramov, Cheng and Metzker, Management Science 2023) report that ML gains shrink a lot once microcaps, distressed firms and costly trades are excluded; that paper was not re-read for this entry.

implementations.notes: Elastic net, trees and NN return prediction examples.
Benchmarks many ML models on stock data.

relevance.reason: Elastic net on macro and carry or momentum features is a sensible, low-variance forecaster for a small set of currencies; this paper is the standard comparison.
